title: Methods of expression of dimensions and direction of manufacture of unprocessed writing and printing paper
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the method of expression of dimensions and direction oi manufacture of unprocessed ( not written upon, not ruled and not punched ) writing and printing paper,

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of terms used in paper trade and industry

clause_3_terminology: Methods of expression of dimensions and direction of manufacture of unprocessed writing and printing paper

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
